# Sample Math Library

A minimal, deterministic Python library providing basic arithmetic, geometric, and number-theoretic operations.

## Basic Arithmetic Operations
The library provides verified methods for addition, subtraction, and multiplication of real numbers.

## Prime Factorization & Number Theory
The library provides primality testing and greatest common divisor computation.

## Geometric Calculations
Calculations for Euclidean distances, vector magnitudes, and hypotenuse lengths.
